# Success Metrics

Measurements of Zuri's performance and growth over 6–12 months.

| Metric | 6-Month Target | 12-Month Target |
|---|---|---|
| **Paying Tenants** | 3 | 10 |
| **MRR** | ฿15,000 | ฿50,000 |
| **Monthly Churn** | < 5% | < 3% |
| **Net Promoter Score (NPS)** | > 50 | > 60 |
| **Inbox Response Time** | < 5 min | < 2 min |
| **ROAS Accuracy** | ±10% | ±5% |
